title: Teardown: machines you can take apart
intro: Three working machines built from code in real units. Every gauge reads the same model that moves the parts. Drag to orbit, press a part to open it, or let the tour drive.
credits: Machines by Elvar (elvarofficial/teardown), built on whaleyxbt/claude-motion and three.js.

pages.name: v8-live
pages.title: V8 engine simulator
pages.description: A cross-plane V8 you can take apart: isolate a cylinder, cut it open, track the firing order and watch its pressure loop close every 720° of crank.

pages.name: cessna-live
pages.title: Cessna 337 landing gear simulator
pages.description: One actuator, a 201 mm rack and a 32-tooth pinion swing both main legs through exactly 180°. Fly a takeoff and watch the gear fold away.

pages.name: strandbeest-live
pages.title: Strandbeest simulator
pages.description: Theo Jansen's wind walker: 20 legs on one crankshaft, every joint solved from his 11 link lengths. Change the wind, isolate a leg and trace every foot.
